work.composition: wide horizontal panorama, asymmetric weighting right
work.description: Layered fragments of printed ephemera—a football trading card, photoprints, paper clips, and compass drawings—overlay a warplane outline rendered in fine linework at left, with bold vertical color bands in red, yellow, and blue. Concentric target circles and a compact disc dominate the right half against a dark blue ground.
work.title: Untitled (Plane and Disc, Wide)
